sources.title: mlboydaisuke/Dia2-1B-LiteRT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Dia2-1B (Nari Labs, Apache-2.0) — a two-speaker dialogue text-to-speech model — re-authored to run on-device with LiteRT CompiledModel. Verified on a Pixel 8a (Tensor G3). Dia2 is a Moshi-style RQ-Transformer.

sources.title: coreai-model-zoo/models/s1-mini/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: S1-mini by Superwhisper is a 0.6B text normalizer for speech-to-text output: it takes a raw ASR transcript and rewrites it as clean written text — fillers removed, false starts and self-corrections resolved to whatever the speaker landed on, punctuation and capitalization applied, and spoken numbers, dates, times, currency and email addresses rendered in written form. It is not a chat model ...
